chunks: Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd narrated from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Mīthamī, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī Ḥamzah, who said:

I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say: “Spend, and be certain of replacement, and know that whoever does not spend in obedience to Allah will be tested by having to spend in disobedience to Allah, Mighty and Majestic. And whoever does not walk to fulfill the need of a friend of Allah will be tested by walking to fulfill the need of an enemy of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.”

key_terms.بِالْخَلَفِ: divine replacement or recompense for what is spent
key_terms.حَاجَةِ عَدُوِّ اللَّهِ: the need or cause of an enemy of Allah
key_terms.حَاجَةِ وَلِيِّ اللَّهِ: the need of a friend or loyal servant of Allah
key_terms.فِي طَاعَةِ اللَّهِ: in obedience to Allah and for righteous purposes
key_terms.فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ: in disobedience to Allah and sinful purposes

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about spending in the way of Allah and helping the friends of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that wealth and effort should be directed toward obedience to Allah, with trust that He will provide replacement. It warns that neglecting righteous spending and service can lead a person to expend resources and effort in sinful causes instead.
